summary: Enforce Claw Continuum ownership/effect fencing inside the existing Remote Bridge immediately before new effect dispatch.
reason: A client-side guard cannot prevent a stale worker from arriving after takeover. The executor must validate the current Continuum epoch and bound Attempt at its own effect boundary.

tests.name: remote-bridge-core
tests.evidence: Includes valid fence, stale epoch, missing fence, expired lease, journal-tail authority and duplicate-effect guards.

tests.name: mcp-bridge
tests.evidence: Existing external MCP durable receipt/status/artifact suite passed.

capabilities.reason: Canonical capability truth remains in ui-playbooks device.remote_bridge; this runtime commit implements its executor boundary only.

architecture.reason: Extends the existing Remote Bridge executor and its receipt store. Continuum journal remains mission truth; no new runtime owner or persistence subsystem is introduced.

rollback: Revert this scoped runtime commit, rebuild the Companion and restart through the existing supervised path. Continuum automatic production routing remains disabled.
limitations: No business capability is enrolled into Continuum by this runtime change.
Live synthetic response-loss and stale-fence acceptance is required after deployment.
The current effect admission reads the bounded journal tail from the existing journal file; performance optimization is deferred.
